intro.text: Ensign Biord, a Scadrian special operative under Colonel Dajer, whose remains Dusk and Starling find in the caves.

items.text: Dajer sent Biord and another soldier through the island's cave system, where both died of masher wasp stings after stirring up the hive. Fast-growing moss hid her body from the drones sent to search for them, until Dusk uncovered it, impressed she had survived so long.
